99.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
99.english: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.

100.english: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.

101.english: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

102.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
102.english: And when he was old enough to work with him, he said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Thou wilt find me, if Allah will, of the steadfast.

103.english: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,

104.english: We called unto him: O Abraham!

105.arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
105.english: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.

106.english: Lo! that verily was a clear test.

107.english: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.

108.english: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

110.english: Thus do We reward the good.

111.english: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

112.english: And We gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.

113.arabic: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
113.english: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
